## User Story
As a **[type of user]**, I want **[goal]** so that **[benefit]**.

### Related feature/epic issue
List out any feature/epic issues that are related to this user story

## Acceptance Criteria
List out the minimum acceptance criteria needed to close this task. The criteria shouldn't be too technical, otherwise you should probably be writing a subtask.
- [ ] criteria 1
- [ ] criteria 2
- [ ] criteria ...

## Notes
List out additional context, this can include any design decisions, spikes that were held, meeting with stakeholder, etc.

## Subtasks
Every user story should be broken down into sub-tasks; these are meant to be actual deliverables.
List out all sub-tasks needed to close this user story.
